summary: Retain confirmed release and pinned recovery records in jobs history (unit 8b)

replay.detail: Jobs-only projection folds release and recovery records, rejects intent/pin mismatches and requires a release fact before keeping a running job or consuming an outcome. Replay fixtures retain admission and reject another launch.

schema.detail: No new tables or shared-writer changes; accepted records remain in existing jobs history.

rules.detail: INACTIVE: no production admission, boot hook or activation. 4c-2 and explicit activation must authenticate recovery; historical rows grant no authority.

compatibility.detail: LaunchJournal now durably records a confirmed release with holder PID and immutable admitted host pin before waiting for exit. Failure stops J while leaving uncertainty, never a retry.

manual.detail: No defaults or policy values added; existing public append remains the future writer interface.

recovery.detail: Read-only recovery_facts uses the existing transaction/staleness fence. Jobs projection tests cover canonical replay, unchanged pin, missing release and intent mismatch. Cargo and native execution not run.
